coding.title: 金额转换：拒绝非法输入，避免浮点误差
coding.titleEn: Money parsing without rounding invalid inputs
coding.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 parseCents(value)。value 必须是字符串：允许两端空白；只接受非负十进制金额，整数部分至少一位，小数最多两位；拒绝指数写法、符号、千分位、Infinity、空串、超过两位小数。返回整数分数，超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER 则返回 null。非法类型或格式返回 null。不能把非法值四舍五入成合法值。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。

zh-CN.summary: 本轮派发 51/69 次首轮请求，30 道文本、4 道代码的完整回答全部通过检查。最终取得 12 张静态图和 2 组动画；3 次首轮因 12,288 token 截断，其中 2 次以 32,768 预算独立重试成功。动画轮踏联动可见，但腿部伸缩、关节机械。5 小时额度耗尽产生 2 次 429，18 项未发，默认动画待补，均不计模型答错。default 文档等同 max；实际强度未独立确认，仅按请求参数分组。小样本不能代表综合排名。

en.summary: The batch dispatched 51/69 initial requests. All 30 complete text and 4 complete code answers passed checks. Final outputs comprise 12 static images and 2 animations. Three initial attempts hit the 12,288-token limit; two independent 32,768-token retries succeeded. Cycling components move, but legs stretch and joints look mechanical. The five-hour quota caused two 429 errors and left 18 tasks unsent; default animation remains pending. These quota interruptions are excluded from accuracy. Default is documented as max; effective effort is unconfirmed, so results are grouped by requested parameters. These small fixed tasks do not establish an overall ranking.

notes.zh: 本轮通过 Kimi Coding Plan 原生 Anthropic Messages 协议调用 k3.1-pro，地址 https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages。每组计划 23 题，default / low / max 三组请求参数最多并发 3 个请求；每组内逐题执行。5 小时订阅额度耗尽后停止新请求，未派发任务不伪造记录，额度错误不计为模型答题失败。默认 effort 的文档值为 max；这两组保留独立请求，不当作两个不同能力档位。low / max 使用原生 output_config.effort；不把 thinking 预算当成 effort。输入 token 合计为原生 input_tokens、cache_read_input_tokens 与 cache_creation_input_tokens 之和，原 usage 字段完整保留。初轮 max_tokens=12,288，包含思考和正文；超时 600 秒，temperature / top_p 省略，没有独立设置 thinking.budget_tokens。按订阅额度消耗，不能按官方按量标价换算成实际账单。此前停止的 Chat Completions 子集单独保留。静态与动图源自模型原始 SVG，未修复源码；点评是 AI 助手的定性视觉检查。单次耗时受服务端排队、三个请求的并发和输出长度影响，不能据此建立稳定速度排名。逐次保留请求与返回模型 ID；可变 API 路由不构成内部固定 checkpoint 的独立证明。服务端接受了非法 effort 负向探针，因此无法独立确认 low/max 实际生效。本页仅按实际请求参数分组，不称为已确认的有效档位比较。
notes.en: This batch calls k3.1-pro through Kimi Coding Plan’s native Anthropic Messages endpoint https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages. Each requested default/low/max configuration plans 23 tasks; at most three requests run concurrently, sequentially within each configuration. New dispatches stopped when the five-hour subscription quota was exhausted. Unsent tasks have no fabricated attempt, and quota failures are not scored as model-answer failures. Default is documented as max; omitted-default and explicit-max requests are independent records and are not treated as distinct capability levels. Low/max use native output_config.effort, not a thinking budget. Prompt-token totals sum native input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens; raw usage is retained. Initial max_tokens=12,288 covers thinking plus final output; timeout 600 seconds. Temperature/top_p omitted; no thinking.budget_tokens configured. Requests consume subscription quota; metered list prices are not the actual invoice. The stopped Chat Completions subset stays separate. Images and animation directly render the model’s unchanged SVG. Assessments are qualitative AI-assistant visual inspection. Single-request timings include queueing, concurrency and output-length effects; they do not establish a stable speed ranking. Requested and returned IDs are preserved; a mutable API route is not independent proof of a fixed internal checkpoint. The server accepted the invalid-effort negative control, so the effective low/max semantics are not independently confirmed. Results are grouped by requested parameters, not claimed as a verified effort-level comparison.
notes.visualQaZh: 12 张最终静态成图均已逐张核验：三组钟表角度、柱形图零基线与 2:4:3:5 比例、海报六段中文各一次都符合题目，鹈鹕与车把、踏板的连接也可辨。首轮有三次因 12,288 输出 token 上限截断；默认鹈鹕和 Max 请求组动画分别提高到 32,768 后独立重试成功，两次累计耗时各约 509.41 秒和 534.14 秒。两组已完成动画的轮辐、曲柄和双腿实际运动，4 秒循环无可辨跳变，但腿长有伸缩、膝部机械感明显。默认请求组动画首轮截断后遇订阅额度限制，尚无可发布结果；本轮仍是部分完成，不能声称三组动画齐全，也不能把请求组视作已验证思考强度。
notes.visualQaEn: All 12 final static images were individually checked: the three clocks use the requested angles, bar charts have zero baselines and the 2:4:3:5 height ratio, each poster contains the six required Chinese strings once, and the pelicans connect visibly to handlebars and pedals. Three first attempts hit the 12,288-token limit. Independent 32,768-token retries recovered the default pelican and requested-max animation, with combined times of about 509.41 and 534.14 seconds respectively. Both completed animations visibly move their spokes, crank and legs and show no perceptible four-second loop jump, but legs stretch and knees look mechanical. The default animation remains incomplete after truncation and subscription-quota exhaustion. This remains a partial evaluation, and request groups are not verified reasoning strengths.
